subject: Post-call recap + trial blueprint and data egress checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariel Soto <ariel@reefhealth.ai>; Samir Gupta <samir@reefhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial blueprint (Reef Health)

Hi Ariel / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight trial blueprint so we can move to kickoff if this aligns with your priorities.

High-level pain points you shared:
- Inference cost and latency on episodic clinical note generation is impacting throughput for clinical staff.
- Need strict data egress controls; patient PHI must remain in our VPC or be redacted before leaving.
- Ops overhead: team wants predictable rollout steps and clear owners for access.

Trial goals & success metrics (proposed):
1) Reduce average generation latency for 1k-token notes from 1.4s/token to <=1.0s/token under 95th pct load.
2) Demonstrate per-request token cost reduction of >=30% using prefix caching + batching.
3) Verify data egress & audit logs meet your compliance checklist for initial scope (read-only logs, KMS).

Scope & timeline (2 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): Sign mutual action plan and complete access checklist.
- Week 1: Provision trial environment + ingest sample prompt set (~200 samples) for prompt-evals.
- Week 2: Run evals, review metrics, and joint review to confirm acceptance criteria.

Owners / roles:
- Reef Health: Ariel (product lead), Samir (security/compliance).
- Redwood: Marissa (AM/point), Ben (solutions engineer — runtime config), Rishi (technical lead/support).

Access & initial asks (small list to unblock Week 0):
1) IAM user + S3 read access for sample prompts (or a temporary manifest with the prompt files).
2) Contact for KMS key/approver for audit log access.
3) A short sample of 20 representative notes (redacted) and one long-form note for latency tests.

I attached a draft mutual_action_plan and a data_egress_requirements checklist for you to review. Please flag anything missing or sensitive we should not include.

If this looks good, can we lock a 60-minute kickoff next Tuesday at 10:00 PT? I’ll invite the engineering owners and include an agenda (provisioning, eval plan, access verification).

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0119

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, data_egress_requirements.pdf

From: Ariel Soto <ariel@reefhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@reefhealth.ai>; Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial blueprint (Reef Health)

Thanks Marissa — this is a clean summary and very close to what we discussed. A couple clarifications from our side before we sign the MAP:  

1) Data egress: we cannot permit any unencrypted PHI leaving our VPC. We need confirmation that the trial can run in a private VPC connector or that you can accept already-redacted notes. Samir will outline the exact KMS flow tomorrow.
2) Evaluation prompts: can we add a small set of downstream user checks (clinical accuracy flag and hallucination detection) to the eval rubric? We want an initial quality gate, not just latency/cost.
3) Timeline: our security review may add 3–4 business days. Would you be OK with a soft kickoff next Tuesday but a hard provisioning date dependent on security signoff?

If you’re OK, we’ll send an internal approval note and attach any security exceptions. Appreciate Ben and Rishi being on the thread — Ben, can you confirm whether Redwood supports a VPC connector for trial fleets and what access you need?

—Ariel
Head of Product | Reef Health
ariel@reefhealth.ai

Quoted below: 
> On Sun, Mar 7, 2027 at 3:12 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for the time today...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariel Soto <ariel@reefhealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial blueprint (Reef Health)

Hi Ariel — quick answers from the infra side.

1) VPC/private deployment: Yes — for trials we can provision a VPC peering connection or a private VPC connector into our private control plane. That will keep PHI from hitting public endpoints. For the peering option we’ll need the following: a CIDR block for the peered VPC, the account/project ID, and a named contact for routing tests.

2) KMS: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for trial fleets. If Samir can share the KMS ARN and the principal that will sign for key approvals we’ll get the IAM role prepared.

3) Eval rubric: adding clinical accuracy flags and a hallucination score is straightforward — we typically ingest those as additional columns in the prompt-eval CSV. If you can provide the scoring rules we’ll wire them into the eval harness.

I attached a small trial_config_template.json (just the fields we need for provisioning) and the data_egress_requirements.pdf for reference.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: trial_config_template.json, data_egress_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariel Soto <ariel@reefhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial blueprint (Reef Health)

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Ben and Ariel.

Plan of record:
- Ariel / Samir to share KMS ARN, CIDR block for peering (if we go that route), and the 20-sample prompt set by EOD Friday.
- Rishi will be our provisioning lead; Ben will own runtime tuning during the eval week.
- I’ll send a calendar invite for a 60-minute kickoff next Tuesday at 10:00 PT with an agenda: provisioning checklist, data egress verification, prompt-eval plan, and acceptance criteria.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Reef Health: send KMS ARN + network info (Ariel / Samir) — due Fri 2027-03-12
- Redwood: provide pre-provision instructions & trial_config_template.json filled with placeholders (Ben / Rishi) — due Mon 2027-03-15
- Joint: final sign-off on MAP once security confirms exceptions (all) — target Mon 2027-03-15

If anything changes on your end that affects the security window, please flag it and we’ll shift the hard provisioning date. Looking forward to kicking this off.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
